evidence_slice: Cheshire West and Chester Council's adopted Local Plan (Part Two) policy R 2 allocates Land west of Ravensholme in Tattenhall for residential development of up to 30 dwellings. Policy R 2.A sets site-specific design, landscaping and wildlife-corridor requirements. The Local Plan (Part Two) Land Allocations and Detailed Policies was adopted on 18 July 2019.

field_evidence.site_specific_requirements: sensitive gateway design; landscaped western boundary; retain/enhance Mill Brook wildlife corridor and footpath
